commands.name: dopa
commands.description: DOPA MODE (DOPA as in dopamine): fireworks, recap, daily card, trophies, focus timer

logs: /dopa fireworks     launch a show (on|off: every firework on or off)
/dopa typing        the TYPE meter, typing pips and GO! on or off
/dopa recap         this session: files edited, moves, tokens, limits (/dopa recap copy: to the clipboard)
/dopa daily         draw today's command card; run that command to capture it
/dopa dex           the commands you have used, and the ones you have not tried yet
/dopa trophies      trophies earned, and how to earn the rest
/dopa focus [min]   start a focus timer, 25 minutes by default (/dopa focus stop ends it)
/dopa break [min]   start a break timer, 5 minutes by default
/dopa boss          check this branch's pull request with gh, once, only when you type it
/dopa stats         lifetime level, clears, commits, pull requests, best combo and streak
/dopa sfx           sound effects on or off (also: /dopa mute, /dopa unmute)
/dopa alerts        HP and STAMINA warnings, YOUR TURN and STAGE CLEAR
/dopa meters        the HP / STAMINA / GOLD / LOOT row
/dopa legend        what HP, STAMINA, GOLD, LOOT and HIT measure
/dopa spinner       swap the rainbow spinner back to the stock one
/dopa off           pause DOPA MODE (/dopa on brings it back)
/dopa reset confirm start over from LV 1 (erases your trophies too)
